advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Add tests for the async-arm skip branches of `_require_s3_helper_for_configured_remote`: ConfigError, OSError, and unresolvable-remote (returncode!=0) each proceed to detach (no raise).
evidence: src/rebar/_store/push.py:374 `if resolved.returncode == 0:` guard — the returncode!=0 skip is untested for the async arm
search_files for `_require_s3_helper_for_configured_remote` in tests: (no matches) — only push_tickets_branch is exercised indirectly, and only via the fail-closed s3 case
advisory.finding: The async-arm helper `_require_s3_helper_for_configured_remote` introduces three new best-effort skip branches (ConfigError from tickets_remote -> return; OSError from `_git` -> return; `resolved.returncode != 0` -> skip) but no test exercises any of them. A regression that let any of these propagate/raise would break the async best-effort contract without a failing test.
scenarios: Malformed config on the async push arm
git binary unavailable (OSError) on the async push arm
unresolvable configured remote on the async push arm

advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Add an async-arm test with a non-s3 (and an unresolvable) remote asserting no raise and that the child is detached (Popen called).
evidence: Only `test_push_async_arm_fails_closed_in_parent_before_detach` covers the async arm, wiring `mode="async"` with an s3 URL and helper absent
No async test asserts `spawned != []` (child detached) for a non-s3 or unresolvable remote — the positive/no-op side of the async preflight is unverified
src/rebar/_store/push.py:405 `_require_s3_helper_for_configured_remote(base_path)` sits before the Popen detach; only the raise-before-detach path is asserted
advisory.finding: The async delivery arm is only tested for the s3-missing-helper fail-closed case; there is no async-arm test for a non-s3 remote or an unresolvable remote confirming the parent proceeds to detach the child (Popen called) without raising. The sync arm has a dedicated `test_push_unresolvable_remote_keeps_best_effort_skip`, but the async equivalent (the site where a missing URL misread as S3 would be most damaging, since the child's stderr is discarded) is absent.
scenarios: Async mode with a normal https remote and no helper installed
Async mode with an unresolvable configured remote
